before.description: A rounded beakless head with small inset lateral eyes, skin eyelids and an upturned closed mouth. Original gray epidermis and varied pale healed scars extend across the face and lower jaw, with darker fins. Pigment and wet-skin roughness are separate channels. This is an illustrative adult derived from licensed artist geometry, not a photographic scan.

after.description: A local Blender reconstruction with small almond-shaped eyes, darker periorbital skin, a smoother upturned closed mouth, and a softly edged pale patch wrapping across the chin. The pale jaw marking is one illustrative individual pattern, not a universal sharp triangle. Independent anatomical and photorealism validation remain pending.
